evalSet: FOC-627 CodeGraph trajectory eval set — provenance-keyed corpus of real recorded queries
source: Every entry is drawn from one recorded tool_facts row (live telemetry DB). Provenance key tool_fact_id = sha1(source_path:source_offset:tool_index) as recorded at capture time; the harness re-reads the query's transcript trajectory from the source_path:source_offset the key names.
privacy: Identifiers only (FOC-220): file paths, symbol names, the recorded query arguments, and rubric identifiers. No source text, no tool-result text, no transcript prose is stored in this file.

gradingKinds.reference: the recorded tool result itself supplies the correct answer's identifiers; mustName items are checked as substrings of the answer text (same convention as scripts/codegraph-benchmark-questions.json expectedContains)
gradingKinds.rubric: mustName items are grounded in what the recorded trajectory shows was actually used downstream (later tool calls or the turn's own prose), not in the result text alone

excluded.reason: transcript file deleted since capture — the trajectory is unreadable, so the query cannot be replayed or graded
tool_result_state='missing' — the result never arrived in the recorded transcript, so there is no answer to grade (truncated trajectory)
tool_result_state unresolved (null) and the result was not verified gradeable during curation

curationNote: 167 CodeGraph tool_facts rows existed at curation time (2026-09-28); 21 rows are excluded above, leaving 146 gradeable candidates. 18 entries were selected for run and tool spread (15 distinct runs; explore majority plus node, impact, files and status). Unselected candidates are same-shape variants of selected entries, not exclusions.
